about: Shared by tests/test_vocal_chain.py and the studio's resolveChain tests. A chain written as a string is that preset's chain. Most specific wins: take chain -> voice.characters[character] -> voice.session -> clean; each level replaces the whole chain.

cases.name: nothing set falls back to Clean
every-line sound applies to a take without its own
session Radio, then Ogre picks Monster: an Ogre take follows Monster
session Radio, then Ogre picks Monster: another character's take stays Radio
a character sound without an every-line sound; other characters get Clean
the take's own chain wins over character and session
